question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'Mystery'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• In the paragraph, we have discussed the life of Shakespeare.
 
• Only **option 4** i.e. **mystery** best suits the line: "**Due to the fact that Shakespeare didn't produce an autobiography, little is known about many parts of his life and some of it remains a mystery."**
 
• The word **mystery** means **Something that is difficult or impossible to understand or explain.**

**The correct sentence__**: **​***Due to the fact that Shakespeare didn't produce an autobiography, little is known about many parts of his life and some of it remains a **mystery**.*

**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__****

 
• ​The word **secret **means **'****Something that is kept hidden'.**
 
• The word **history **means **'The study of past'.**
 
• The word **exotic** means **'****Non-native'.**

96:T
